# Bring your own GPU (BYOG)

> Free GPU VRAM calculator and hardware compatibility checker for 500+ open-source AI models.

Bring your own GPU (BYOG) helps AI developers, researchers, and hobbyists instantly find which open-source models fit their GPU. Given a GPU (or custom VRAM budget), a quantization format, and a use case, it returns a ranked list of compatible models sorted by benchmark quality.

It also offers a reverse search: pick a model and a target tokens-per-second, and the tool shows every GPU configuration (single or multi-GPU) that can achieve that speed, sorted by approximate price.

## Key pages

- Home: https://fit-to-metal.up.railway.app/
- GPU → Model tool: https://fit-to-metal.up.railway.app/tool
- Reverse search (model → hardware): https://fit-to-metal.up.railway.app/reverse
- Model index: https://fit-to-metal.up.railway.app/models

## How VRAM is calculated

VRAM required = (parameters × bytes_per_param) + 20% overhead
- FP16/BF16: 2 bytes per parameter
- INT8: 1 byte per parameter
- INT4/GGUF Q4: 0.5 bytes per parameter
- FP32: 4 bytes per parameter

Example: Llama 3.1 70B at FP16 = 70B × 2 bytes × 1.2 overhead ≈ 141 GB VRAM

## Supported hardware

200+ GPU profiles across NVIDIA (RTX 50/40/30-series), AMD Radeon, Apple Silicon (M4/M3/M2), NVIDIA workstation (A-series, L40S), and data center (H100, A100, B200, GB200).

## Supported model types

LLM / chat, image generation, audio / speech recognition, computer vision, video generation, embeddings.

## Quantization formats

FP32, FP16, BF16, INT8, INT4, GGUF Q4, GGUF Q8
